relationships.subject: Furosemide
relationships.evidence_quote: Furosemide, but not vehicle, reduced paw withdrawal and muscle pressure threshold in a dose-dependent manner

relationships.evidence_quote: SNL decreased α6 subunit protein expression at the spinal cord (Fig. 5A) and DRG (Fig. 5B) from 3 to 21 days after injury.

relationships.subject: PZ-II-029
relationships.evidence_quote: repeated administration of PZ-II-029 also restored protein expression of the α6 subunit in the spinal cord

relationships.subject: PZ-II-029
relationships.evidence_quote: reduced the number of spontaneous flinches and increased rearing behavior at 2 h post-administration

relationships.subject: spinal nerve ligation
relationships.evidence_quote: nerve injury decreases the function and expression of KCC2 in neurons of lamina I of the superficial dorsal horn

key_findings: Spinal α6-containing GABAA receptor blockade or knockdown induces pain in naive female rats, and nerve injury reduces its expression.
α6 PAMs (Ro 15-4513, PZ-II-029) and Gabra6 plasmid overexpression reduce neuropathic pain, with greater effect in females.
